comments.body: Landed as e8b09ae3 (msg), d9236891 (api), 8d798e75 (cli), e9d601a0 (window); gate green. Plan reviewed by Codex gpt-6.1-sol xhigh (not ready, 2 P2 accepted: CLI asks for protocol 1.10 since an older daemon drops the field silently, and a visible Recommended label rather than color); code reviewed by Claude opus medium (no findings; two small notes taken). Shape: recommended = the text of one offered answer, empty/absent for none, changes nothing about answering. Refused recommended_not_offered (API INVALID) when not one of the answers; recommended_unsupported (API UNSUPPORTED) toward a group home before protocol 1.10. API 0.3 NewPost.recommended = 9 and Post.recommended = 9; Welcome option msg.post.recommended. CLI muster msg post --option A --option B --recommend N; read/log print (recommended), --json has recommended. Window: Recommended label beside the answer in banner and conversation, picks nothing, no focus.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The owner, 2026-11-02, from Foreman's phone app: "Maybe, from muster's perspective, maybe we want some sort of, uh, way to, um, allow the agents to recommend a specific option and express that through muster and inform and can render that."

Agents asking the owner a question say which answer they recommend in prose ("I recommend the first"). Wanted: `muster msg post --option ... ` can mark one option as the recommended one, the API carries it on the post (`NewPost` and the logged post), Muster's window shows it, and a client such as Foreman's phone app renders it. `muster docs msg` tells agents to use it when they have a recommendation. Foreman card: a_2sgOdZ0hm.
title: msg post: let a question mark one offered answer as recommended
